_comment: Workspace identity colors adopted as default 15 Sept 2026 - remapped to a gemstone motif (real hex references researched: emerald #1F6F54, navy/sapphire #1B2A4A family, burgundy/garnet #6E1E2E-#830E0D family, antique gold #B8860B/24k gold #C69B3C, charcoal/onyx #2E3440-#0A0A0A, platinum/smoky quartz #9B9A9D - see zoviz.com/blog/luxury-brand-colors-meanings, digiquack.com/luxury-brand-color-palettes, madegooddesigns.com's burgundy/gold-pairing pages, color-name.com's garnet entry). Ties into the already-adopted Sapphire chrome theme's own navy/gold language (Theme.qml's default theme) - previewed live end-to-end, then confirmed by Akash. Semantic mapping (status.positive->lab, status.warning->arena, status.critical->range) preserved exactly, just richer jewel tones of the same hue family each already had.
_tierLightsComment: Added 17 Sept 2026 (Akash: the Agents tab's green/yellow/red tier badges 'must be different colour than our workspace colours') - unlike status.* above, these are deliberately NOT reused workspace hues (Lab's muted emerald, Arena's brownish gold, Range's dark garnet are all too close to each other and to this same tier concept to read as a real traffic light at a glance). Real saturated traffic-light colors instead, used only for the Agents tab's tier lights.
